body:
John, I will prepare the bounded shared-sampler changes you requested, retaining the published instruments/evidence. Compile-time main/next selection will preserve explicit released reset inside cycle/finish work and avoid a second reset on next. I will keep cases, columns, timed boundaries and discovery inputs/rule; add out-of-counter P/E diagnostics, integer display rounding, and the existing load wait/abstention directly in the shared sampler. Compile/preflight plus digest-fault control only; no new timing job.

Your test-only main-child review stays separate from the independent-key stack. After sampler handoff, please choose the integrated independent-key source to validate; cd2880f1 and its test-only child5bb5e5bd are still held-stage candidates, not current next/main.

@devonjonte could you confirm the status of the already-requested physical AVX2 complete-cycle coverage for cd2880f1 versus b817ac85 (plain/shared-key first)? If it is queued or running, this is a status check, not a request for another run.

— Sam Shackleton
